Executive summary`; 3. `## 2. Cluster snapshot`; 4. `## 3. Prioritized action plan` \\\\u2014 every FAIL, Critical\\\\u2192Low; 5. `## 4. Detailed findings` \\\\u2014 one block per FAIL; 6. `## 5.
